name: @storyengine/shared
description: Portable types and schemas. No runtime dependencies, by design (docs/design/07-tech-stack.md §10).
dependencyNote: TypeBox and Ajv are the two exceptions to the no-runtime-deps line above, and they are not really exceptions: schemas are runtime values, so the authoring library (07 §4) and the validator that reads the emitted JSON Schema have to travel with them. Both are dependency-free themselves. ajv-formats was considered and dropped — date-time is the only format any portable schema uses, and a regex is cheaper than a dependency. Nothing else belongs here.
